string.value: #cDouble-click# this Medal of Honor to receive Honor EXP.

string.name: desc
string.value: Allows entry to the Jewel Pop stage. #cDouble-click# to use. Cannot be used after the event period.

string.name: desc
string.value: A mysterious box that includes items for #cJewel Craft#. Cannot be used after the event period.

string.name: desc
string.value: A box that contains #cS Rank and A Rank# Jewels for Jewel Craft. Double-click to open.

string.name: desc
string.value: A surprise from the Orange Mushroom. Double-click to see what it is.

string.name: desc
string.value: Contains the entire Stellar Equipment Set. Double-click to open. Can only be used after your 2nd Job Advancement to get Demon Avenger or Xenon equipment. Sadly, it contains no weapons.

string.name: desc
string.value: Open the box to receive a #cRed Loose-Fit Beanie, Rising Star Baggy Digs, Booster Shoes, and a Partly Cloudy Cape#.

string.name: desc
string.value: This box is full of lovely gifts. Double-click to receive one of several rare and precious gifts. Can only be opened before 04/09/13.

string.name: desc
string.value: Double-click to receive a 1,000,000 Mesos Comfort Fund coin.

string.name: desc
string.value: One of Lolo's old teleport scrolls. It'll take you wherever you want. Only usable for a week.

string.name: desc
string.value: An ice chest full of goodies to help you stay cool in the summer time. The contents will melt if you don't open it up by 09/11/12.

string.name: desc
string.value: A special gift box from #cMaple Administrator#. Limit one per day. Not even Maple Administrator knows what's inside. \n#cDouble-click# to open.

string.name: desc
string.value: Raise a cute Orange Imp in your item pot by #cdouble-clicking# this item.\nGrow your imp by feeding it gear that's similar to your level. It will reward you when it's fully grown!

string.name: desc
string.value: Raise a cute Gemstone Imp in your item pot by #cdouble-clicking# this item.\nGrow your imp by feeding it gear that's similar to your level. It will reward you when it's fully grown!
